context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 UI fixes verified: 1) Account card shows athlete.email not parent email, 2) 'Email 2° Genitore' removed from read-only view (only in edit modal), 3) 'Calcola Codice Fiscale' not in read-only view. P1 admin terms: Two mandatory checkboxes implemented (terms + data processor), both must be checked for button to enable. Known limitation: Playwright cannot persist React Native Web auth state (AsyncStorage/Zustand), so authenticated pages cannot be directly automated. Use API testing or code verification instead.
